description: This file defines the WebSocketRouteDispatcher class, which manages WebSocket routes within the Playwright core server infrastructure. It handles the creation, event handling, and communication with WebSocket routes, including exposing bindings to the page context, managing event listeners for page lifecycle events, and facilitating message passing between the page and server.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class managing WebSocket route lifecycle, event dispatching, and communication between the page and server within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Static method to install WebSocket mock bindings and setup event listeners for WebSocket routing.

methods.description: Static method to remove installed WebSocket mock bindings and clean up scripts.

methods.description: Connects the WebSocket route, initiating WebSocket connection logic.

methods.name: ensureOpened
methods.description: Ensures that the WebSocket connection is open.

methods.name: sendToPage
methods.description: Sends a message from the server to the page through the WebSocket.

methods.name: sendToServer
methods.description: Sends a message from the page to the server through the WebSocket.

methods.name: closePage
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection from the page side.

methods.name: closeServer
